description.plain_text: F_RigRemoval 4.6v4.539224 F_RigRemoval is used to remove foreground items from a scene, using inter-frame motion to guess at a reconstruction for the missing data behind the foreground object. The foreground region has to be masked through the whole sequence, either with a white shape in the Mask sequence, using the box region or using the alpha channel. Red regions indicate areas which haven't (or can't) be reconstructed. It may be necessary to increase Frames Used to include more frames before the repair can be completed. RigRemoval performs best where the background behind the foreground object is 'static'; that is - apart from DVE-style moves it doesn't vary much from frame to frame. Help->Documentation contains a more detailed description of this plug-in. Copyright 2026 The Foundry all rights reserved.
description.text:
F_RigRemoval 4.6v4.539224

F_RigRemoval is used to remove foreground items from a scene, using inter-frame motion to guess at a reconstruction for the missing data behind the foreground object.

The foreground region has to be masked through the whole sequence, either with a white shape in the Mask sequence, using the box region or using the alpha channel.

Red regions indicate areas which haven't (or can't) be reconstructed. It may be necessary to increase Frames Used to include more frames before the repair can be completed.

RigRemoval performs best where the background behind the foreground object is 'static'; that is - apart from DVE-style moves it doesn't vary much from frame to frame.

Help->Documentation contains a more detailed description of this plug-in.
